purpose: Self-contained curated index for first-battle original-runtime visual evidence used by camera, projection, hit-test, movement-overlay, menu-placement, opening, and cancel/return work.
capture_notes: All evidence files referenced by this manifest are curated under docs/evidence_packets/runtime_observations/first_battle_visuals/.
Opening frames were preserved from the original lossless PNG when available or recovered from the original 2 fps window-only recording at the indexed frame number.
First-control and Move-route images were recovered losslessly from the existing Godot texture import cache after their ignored source PNGs had been deleted.
PNG dimensions include host window chrome; game content is observed as a 2x capture of the original 640x480 logical client area.
Filename route labels are hints only. The visual_state and status fields below come from direct image inspection.
known_missing_evidence: first_control_idle_no_menu: no confirmed local original-runtime frame has been promoted yet that proves first-control standing formation with no dialogue, no action menu, and no Move overlay
opening_camera_curve: promoted opening-recording frames are discrete anchors, not a measured curve or scroll speed
opening_enemy_friendly_entry_paths: promoted frames show visible positions, not complete per-actor path/timing semantics

evidence.visual_state: opening rain/background transition before battlefield map
observations: This promoted recording frame is a transition/background anchor, not a battlefield formation frame.

evidence.visual_state: opening castle-wall transition graphic, not battlefield camera
use_for: negative guard against mistaking transition frames for map camera frames
observations: Manual inspection shows a black-background castle-wall transition graphic. Do not cite it as the bridge/gate battlefield view.

not_for: confirmed first-control idle with no UI
observations: Leonard and lower friendly units are visible without a dialogue box or action menu. This is still a pre/dialogue-sequence frame, not by itself first-control ready proof.

observations: This frame constrains dialogue presentation and map context, but text decoding remains a separate unresolved message-resource task.

proof that player control has started

evidence.visual_state: soldier dialogue UI over lower formation
observations: This frame confirms a soldier dialogue presentation after the map-only gap; it is still not player-control proof.

evidence.visual_state: upper gate/bridge formation route frame with multiple units visible

observations: This route frame shows the upper gate/bridge formation context. It is a promoted visual anchor, not proof of final player-control state.

observations: This route frame is a second promoted upper-formation anchor. It should be used with p1_route_upper_formation_11, not as a complete choreography proof.

use_for: first-control camera crop after route confirmation
observations: Manual inspection shows an action menu already open. Do not cite this as pure no-menu first-control formation.
Action menu is open around Leonard in the same map/camera view as the Move overlay baseline.
The image constrains menu anchoring and first-control camera context, not command handler semantics.

evidence.visual_state: first-control action menu open with move command focus/cursor nearby
observations: This remains an action-menu frame; it is not the blue movement-grid frame.

evidence.visual_state: Move command selected; blue movement range overlay visible
use_for: blue grid pitch and alignment preflight
movement range shape and blocker omissions
camera viewport reference for movement interaction
observations: Blue movement cells are axis-aligned square cells over the battlefield view.

Manual inspection suggests the cell pitch is about 64 capture pixels, i.e. about 32 logical game pixels at the current 2x capture scale; this must be checked by a dedicated pixel/contact-sheet checker before becoming a constant.
The Move overlay, Leonard position, visible actors, foreground trees, and camera crop must be treated as one spatial contract, not independent UI decoration.

evidence.visual_state: Move range overlay still visible after captured Esc route step
use_for: negative evidence that route filename alone cannot prove cancel return
observations: Direct inspection shows the blue movement overlay is still visible. Do not cite this as cancel-return proof.

evidence.visual_state: Move range overlay still visible after captured right-click route step
use_for: negative evidence that route filename alone cannot prove cancel return
observations: Direct inspection shows the blue movement overlay is still visible. Do not cite this as cancel-return proof.

evidence.visual_state: action menu visible after right-click return/retry route
observations: This frame can support that the route reached an action-menu state again; it does not alone prove the exact cancel transition timing.

evidence.visual_state: action menu visible after move-space-confirm route
observations: The frame shows an action menu again after the movement route. It does not prove the original movement path or timing.

forbidden_or_downgraded_sources.reason: Deleted historical Godot implementation; history can explain prototype wiring only, not original-runtime visual truth.
Removed from the active repository because curated local original-runtime evidence supersedes them. Recoverable from the pre-cleanup Git bundle if historical archaeology is ever required.
Raw historical directories are not evidence entries. Use a specific curated evidence id and file from this manifest.

gate_rules: Any task touching camera crop, grid-to-world projection, actor foot anchors, movement overlay drawing, hit-test, movement range generation, foreground z-order, or movement/cancel menu placement must cite at least one confirmed evidence entry from this manifest.
For Move overlay implementation or review, move_overlay_primary is mandatory until superseded by a newer confirmed original-runtime Move overlay entry.

For opening choreography, dialogue UI, or formation work, cite specific promoted opening-recording or p1-route evidence ids from this manifest; do not cite raw recording, route, or legacy capture directories wholesale.
There is currently no confirmed first_control_idle_no_menu evidence id. Do not claim a pure no-menu first-control standing formation until a specific original-runtime frame is promoted.
A filename or route step is not evidence by itself. If visual_state is not confirmed, inspect the image or create a contact sheet/checker before using it.
Negative-for-cancel entries may be used to avoid bad claims, but not as proof of cancel-return behavior.
Superseded Godot captures, uncurated visual-alignment packages, raw screenshots, and external videos cannot be the sole source for original visual truth.

The current implementation may still carry provisional formulas and incomplete scroll behavior, but it may not proceed with movement/hit-test/camera code that contradicts the confirmed Move overlay spatial contract.
